# Territorial Overseas Exarchate for the Western (Atlantic / Hesperia) corridor.
oe_far_exarchate = {
    type = location
    subject_pays = subject_pays_colonial
    color = subject_colonial_nation
    annullment_favours_required = 10
    shares_exploration_with_overlord = yes
    level = 1

    join_offensive_wars_always = {
        NOT = { scope:actor ?= { is_subject_of = scope:recipient } }
    }
    join_offensive_wars_can_call = {
        trigger_if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = {
                    is_subject_of = scope:actor
                }
            }
            scope:recipient ?= {
                NOT = {
                    any_international_organizations_member_of = {
                        international_organization_type = international_organization_type:colonial_federation
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        trigger_else = {
            always = yes
        }
    }
    join_defensive_wars_always = {
        trigger_if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = {
                    is_subject_of = scope:actor
                }
            }
            scope:recipient ?= {
                NOT = {
                    any_international_organizations_member_of = {
                        international_organization_type = international_organization_type:colonial_federation
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        trigger_else = {
            always = yes
        }
    }

    has_overlords_ruler = no
    will_join_independence_wars = yes
    can_be_annexed = no
    is_colonial_subject = yes

    diplomatic_capacity_cost_scale = 0.5
    maritime_path_tolerance = 0.5
    strength_vs_overlord = -0.05

    subject_can_cancel = no
    overlord_can_cancel = no
    has_limited_diplomacy = yes
    allow_declaring_wars = {
        colonial_nation_can_declare_wars_trigger = yes
    }

    fleet_basing_rights = yes
    food_access = yes
    subject_exempt_from_overlord_import_tariffs = yes
    overlord_exempt_from_subject_import_tariffs = yes
    can_overlord_build_rgos = yes
    can_overlord_build_ships = yes
    can_overlord_build_buildings = yes
    overlord_share_exploration = yes
    allow_subjects = no
    can_change_rank = yes
    can_change_heir_selection = no
    minimum_opinion_for_offer = 100
    great_power_score_transfer = 0.75
    merchants_to_overlord_fraction = 0.33
    government = monarchy

    institution_spread_to_overlord = monthly_institution_spread_severe
    institution_spread_to_subject = monthly_institution_spread_severe

    overlord_modifier = {
    }
    subject_modifier = {
        global_population_capacity_modifier = 0.10
        loyalty_to_overlord = 20
    }

    creation_visible = { always = no }
    visible_through_diplomacy = { always = no }
    visible_through_treaty = { always = no }
    enabled_through_diplomacy = { always = no }
    release_country_enabled = { always = no }
    on_enable = {}
    on_disable = {}
}
